name: A computer's network: open, limited or closed
what: Each computer's network is open, limited to a list of hosts, or closed, and you open or close it in one step. Even when it is open, a computer cannot reach your Mac, your local network, your VPN or cloud metadata. Nothing done inside the computer changes these settings.

suggest.why: Every other limit at the edge of a computer (secrets, the hosts in the record, the age of packages) stands on this one.
